Team.title: Team
Team.description: Represents a participating family or team in the quiz competition

isLoggedIn.description: Whether the team is logged in and active

buzzerPressed.description: Flag indicating if this team pressed the buzzer for the active question

buzzerTime.description: Timestamp in milliseconds when buzzer was pressed

pin.description: Security PIN used to sign into the team profile

GameState.title: GameState
GameState.description: Master synchronized state of the live quiz show

currentQuestion.description: Current question text shown to audience

mediaUrl.description: URL to MP4 video, YouTube link, or image file

mediaType.description: Type of media to render on projector

timerDuration.description: Total countdown duration in seconds (e.g. 15 or 60)

timerEndTime.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when timer expires

buzzerActive.description: Whether buzzers are currently enabled for contestants

buzzerLocked.description: Whether buzzer is locked after first team buzzed

buzzedTeam.description: Name of the first team that pressed the buzzer

showWinner.description: Grand finale trigger flag to reveal winner on projector screen

screenState.description: Primary visual mode on projector display

/teams/{teamId}.description: Collection of contestant teams and scores

/gameState/{stateId}.description: Central singleton game state document (usually stateId = 'active')
